acceptance.given: When a subprocess capability requests shell evaluation under the A20 capability contract

oracle.expected: The subprocess operation returns a failure result and no shell-evaluated command proceeds.
forbidden: A subprocess operation using shell evaluation succeeds or proceeds.
oracle.observable: The subprocess invocation result and execution trace show a failed shell-evaluation attempt with no executed shell command.

acceptance.then: The shell-evaluation attempt is rejected before execution.
acceptance.when: The subprocess boundary guard evaluates the invocation request.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the subprocess-boundary test that requests shell evaluation and assert the invocation fails without proceeding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject subprocess requests that enable shell evaluation and return a deterministic failure.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Shell-evaluation request transitions from attempted execution to explicit rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted test observes a failed shell-evaluation attempt with no shell command execution.

acceptance.given: When a subprocess capability is defined or invoked under the A20 contract

oracle.expected: The capability definition contains a finite timeout value.
forbidden: A subprocess capability has no timeout declaration.
A subprocess capability declares a non-finite timeout.
oracle.observable: Capability metadata or invocation configuration exposes a present finite timeout value.

acceptance.then: The capability is accepted only with a finite timeout declaration.
acceptance.when: The capability declaration validator evaluates timeout configuration.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run capability validation against subprocess definitions with missing or non-finite timeout and assert validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every subprocess capability to declare a finite timeout.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Timeout metadata transitions from unverified to validated finite.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation fails for missing or non-finite timeout and passes for finite values.

acceptance.when: The capability declaration validator evaluates cancellation and process-tree ownership metadata.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run capability validation against a subprocess definition missing cancellation/process-tree ownership and assert validation fails.

slice_hint.state_transition: Ownership metadata transitions from missing to explicit cancellation/process-tree ownership.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation fails when owner metadata is absent and passes when a valid owner is declared.

acceptance.given: When the validator performs local filesystem inspection for a package

oracle.expected: All filesystem checks remain within the validator's declared local inspection boundary, and an outside sentinel is neither read into output nor modified.
forbidden: The validator checks beyond its local inspection boundary.
The validator fails to execute its local inspection boundary.
oracle.observable: A boundary-focused test records inspected paths and sentinel state, showing every inspected path is contained and the outside sentinel is unchanged.

acceptance.then: The validator's filesystem inspection is constrained to its declared local boundary.
acceptance.when: The validator runs local filesystem checks and the boundary test evaluates the inspection trace and sentinel state.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the validator boundary test with an escaping path or outside symlink fixture and assert the check fails or refuses the out-of-bound path while leaving the sentinel unchanged.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the validator's declared local filesystem boundary and reject escaping paths or symlink traversal.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validator inspection transitions from potentially unconstrained access to contained local-boundary checks.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Boundary validation observes only in-root paths, rejects escapes, and leaves the outside sentinel unchanged.
